newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Vickers Ballas in one-for-one bonus issue.
newsitem.headline: Vickers Ballas in one-for-one bonus issue.

text.p: Stockbroker Vickers Ballas Holdings Ltd said on Wednesday it was proposing a one-for-one bonus issue.
It said in a statement accompanying its 1996 results the bonus issue would result in an increase in its issued share capital by Singapore $60.88 million to S$121.76 million.

The bonus issue was proposed in view of the good performance of the group and "the resultant increase in the capital base of the company will support the growth in business operations and asset base of the group," the statement said.
Vickers also proposed to increase its authorised share capital to S$200 million from S$100 million currently.
The company reported that its 1996 net profits rose 41 percent to S$48.55 million.
